newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia sells 0.04 pct of oil firm Yeniseineftegaz.
newsitem.headline: Russia sells 0.04 pct of oil firm Yeniseineftegaz.

text.p: Investors bought 0.04 percent of the state's stake in AO Yeniseineftegaz oil exploration company at the starting price of 50,000 roubles a share, the Russian Federal Property Fund said on Monday.
Investors bought 142 shares out of 75,455 offered for the auction, it said.

Shares in the company, which belongs to Russian independent oil group East Siberian Oil & Gas Company (Vostochno-Sibirskaya Neftegazovaya Kompaniya), were sold at an auction between December 11, 1996 and January 10, 1997.
At the previous auction held between September 11 and October 11, 1996, investors bought 2.2 percent of the company out of 22.0 percent offered at 50,000 roubles a share.
East Siberian Oil & Gas Company owns 38 percent of Yeniseineftegaz, whose authorised capital is 381.12 million roubles.
